name: Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance Co., Ltd.
summary: Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance Co., Ltd., operating with its subsidiaries both domestically in South Korea and across international markets, delivers a comprehensive array of non-life insurance products and services. Its extensive portfolio encompasses general insurance, covering risks such as fire for residential, commercial, and industrial properties; marine insurance for hulls, aircraft, and cargo; and policies for engineering projects, casualty events, and liability. The company also provides protection for injury and sickness. Furthermore, it offers long-term insurance solutions, including driver, property, savings, and personal pension plans, in addition to comprehensive auto insurance. Rounding out its services, Samsung Fire & Marine Insurance provides a selection of loan products, including apartment mortgages, loans secured by insurance policies, and credit loans. Founded in 1952, the company maintains its headquarters in Seoul, South Korea.
